name: Azimut Holding S.p.A.
summary: Azimut Holding S.p.A. provides asset management and advisory solutions in Italy, Europe, the Middle East, the Americas, and the Asia-Pacific. It offers public and private markets, discretionary portfolio management, and token and digital asset solutions; advisory services; corporate investment banking and fintech solutions; mutual funds harmonized with the UCITS directive; alternative investment funds and open pension funds; and individual management of investment portfolios on behalf of third parties.
